Spend £75 or more on qualifying STANLEY or STANLEY FATMAX hand tools or storage products to claim a FREE STANLEY FATMAX XTREME 120cm Box Beam Level (FMHT43676-1). UK & ROI residents aged 18+ only. Purchase on or between 01.09.2026 - 24.11.2026. Claim online at STANLEYtools.co.uk by 07.12.2026 with proof of purchase. 5,000 available, first come, first served. Full T&Cs apply. Manufacturer promotion.

The Stanley tool chest is a large-capacity mobile storage solution manufactured from durable plastic, providing water and weather-resistant protection for tools and equipment. The hinged lid with metal clamps ensures secure closure during transport, while integrated organisers store small bits and accessories. A built-in V-groove in the lid supports controlled timber cutting when required. Transport wheels and carrying handles allow easy movement across site, with a telescopic handle improving handling. Offering a 50 litre internal capacity and supporting loads up to 40 kg, this non-stacking tool chest suits construction, maintenance and installation work where secure, mobile tool storage is essential.
